biography: Sebastián 'El Rayo' Merchán, a name synonymous with flamboyant racing and unwavering ambition in the GT world, hails from the high-altitude city of Quito, Ecuador. His journey began not on a racetrack, but on the winding mountain roads where he honed his skills in a battered Toyota Corolla, much to the chagrin of his father, a respected surgeon who envisioned a different path for his son. Sebastián’s racing career officially ignited at the age of 22, when he traded his Corolla for a kart and dominated local competitions. His breakout moment came during a support race at the 24 Hours of Daytona, where, despite starting last due to a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field to finish second, earning the attention of Lamborghini's junior program. Now at the peak of his career, Sebastián is a leading figure in the Lamborghini racing scene, known for his aggressive overtakes and unwavering self-belief, constantly striving to elevate his performance and claim championship glory.
drivingStyle: Sebastián is known for his aggressive and daring driving style. He is a late-braking specialist, often pushing the limits of grip to gain positions in the corners. While his aggressive approach can sometimes lead to spectacular overtakes, it also occasionally results in costly errors. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, as he tends to overdrive the car early in a stint, sacrificing late-race pace. Under pressure, Sebastián thrives, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest. He is a natural risk-taker and enjoys the challenge of close wheel-to-wheel racing.
